acceptance_tests: The graph is the actual two-cube graph, not an outer-boundary simplification, and every face/link used in V has a signed incidence record.
The strict cutoff E_el < 6*alpha is enforced exactly. A channel with E_el = 6*alpha is exhibited and excluded, or its absence is proved and the gate is limited/rejected accordingly.
All physical channels below cutoff are enumerated without duplicates, including nonplanar cycles and vertex intertwiner multiplicities.

If complete proof supports the anticipated classification, vacuum plus all four-edge and six-edge fundamental simple cycles are included; no unsupported selected examples may stand in for completeness.
P is proved to reduce H0 before W^*W is used as a complement object.

The exact full cross Gram P V^2 P - (P V P)^2 is computed for the declared P and V, or the result is explicitly limited with the original exact-Gram obligation still open and a concrete obstruction recorded.
Normal and optimized executions are deterministic and counted once.
Independent comparison reconstructs graph enumeration, scale fields, threshold exclusion and Gram entries rather than trusting producer pass booleans.
falsifying_controls: Drop one nonplanar six-edge simple cycle or one allowed intertwiner and require the independent comparison to fail.
Replace the actual two-cube graph by the outer boundary-only graph and require graph-incidence checks to fail.
Include a threshold E_el = 6*alpha channel in P and require strict-cutoff checks to fail.
Present PV^2P without subtracting (PVP)^2 as the exact cross Gram and require rejection.
Present a conservative norm upper bound as if it were the exact cross Gram and require rejection or limited status.
Use kappa, numerical tolerance, volume, Fibonacci index or E_star=0 as the energy scale and require rejection.
Promote a Ritz matrix gap or sampled basis gap to the full complement threshold without channel completeness and require rejection.
goal: Goal B loop 1: complete strict-cutoff low-energy projector and full cross Gram on the actual two-cube SU(2) graph
non_claims: B1 does not prove a continuous finite spectral domain, homogeneous dense stability or continuum mass gap.
B1 does not discharge the original exact cross-Gram obligation if it returns only a conservative substitute.
B1 does not import A2's product-representation summability as a finite two-cube dense spectral result.

physical_contract.energy_scale: freeze E_star>0 and report alpha/E_star and all lambda_f/alpha separately; do not normalize by kappa, tolerance, volume, Fibonacci index or static Euclidean coefficients.
physical_contract.gauge_sector: physical SU(2) gauge-invariant spin-network sector with vertex intertwiners counted explicitly.
physical_contract.graph: actual two-cube graph with internal/shared faces and all independent links/faces declared by signed incidence; the outer boundary-only graph is an invalid substitute.
physical_contract.hamiltonian: H = alpha * sum_e C_e - sum_f lambda_f x_f on the actual two-cube graph; C_e=j_e(j_e+1) and x_f=ReTr(U_f)/2 in the established Round18/Round19 convention.
physical_contract.potential: V = - sum_f lambda_f x_f over the declared face set; the cross-block object is W^*W = P V^2 P - (P V P)^2 after proving P reduces H0.
physical_contract.strict_cutoff: P is the complete physical electric-energy projector for E_el < 6*alpha above the vacuum. Threshold channels at E_el = 6*alpha are excluded by strict inequality.

backward: independently reconstruct the low-energy channel enumeration from the desired strict-cutoff statement rather than importing the producer's list
independently count nonplanar cycles and intertwiners and compare against the forward list for duplicates and omissions
independently verify the threshold channel at E_el = 6*alpha is excluded from P
recompute or independently check the full cross Gram W^*W; if only a conservative upper bound is supplied, certify that it is labeled limited and that the original exact-Gram obligation remains open
run mutation controls for omitted nonplanar cycles, outer-boundary substitution, threshold inclusion, missing P subtraction and conservative-bound-as-identity claims
forward: declare the actual two-cube signed graph incidence, faces and orientation conventions used by every calculation
enumerate every gauge-invariant physical channel with E_el < 6*alpha, including nonplanar simple cycles and all vertex intertwiner multiplicities
prove P reduces H0 and give the exact complement threshold statement
exhibit an actual physical channel at E_el = 6*alpha that is omitted by the strict cutoff, or prove that the anticipated threshold witness is absent and downgrade the target
compute the full exact cross Gram W^*W = P V^2 P - (P V P)^2 for the declared P and V, with symbolic/rational dependence on the face couplings whenever feasible
produce source manifests, exact output files, ordinary/optimized deterministic runs and wrong-model controls

stop_condition: Stop B1 after either a complete strict-cutoff enumeration with full exact cross Gram and controls, or a precise limited/rejected obstruction naming the first missing channel/Gram computation barrier. Do not choose or execute B2 until the B1 gate records the actual evidence.
target_statement: If the full cutoff proof supports it, B1 should classify P as the vacuum plus all physical fundamental simple-cycle channels below 6*alpha, including all four-edge and six-edge cycles, with nonplanar cycles and intertwiner multiplicities counted. If that classification is incomplete or false, B1 must return a limited/rejected result with the first missing or extra channel identified.
